electricity.name: Grid Electricity (Indian National Grid Average)
electricity.source: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector, User Guide Version 19.0 (Dec 2023), Table 1
electricity.notes: Verified official CEA baseline: Represents the National Grid Weighted Average Gross Generation Emission Factor (including Renewable Energy Sources) of 0.716 t CO2/MWh (0.716 kg CO2e/kWh) for Fiscal Year 2022-23 from CEA CO2 Baseline Database v19.0 (Dec 2023), Table 1. Note: This is the national grid weighted average gross generation factor, not the Combined Margin (CM ~0.76-0.79 t CO2/MWh) or Operating Margin (OM).

petrol.name: Motor Gasoline / Petrol
petrol.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Vol 2, Ch 3
petrol.notes: Default emission factor for motor gasoline combustion. Does not include upstream extraction and refining (well-to-tank) emissions.

diesel.name: Gas / Diesel Oil
diesel.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Vol 2, Ch 3
diesel.notes: Default emission factor for diesel combustion in road and stationary generators. Tank-to-wheel direct combustion boundary.

transport_car_petrol.name: Passenger Car (Petrol, Vehicle-km)
transport_car_petrol.source: UK DEFRA / DESNZ Greenhouse Gas Reporting: Conversion Factors 2023
transport_car_petrol.notes: Average medium petrol passenger car direct combustion emissions per vehicle-kilometre (vkm). Appropriate for single-occupant travel or total vehicle distance.

transport_car_diesel.name: Passenger Car (Diesel, Vehicle-km)
transport_car_diesel.source: UK DEFRA / DESNZ Greenhouse Gas Reporting: Conversion Factors 2023
transport_car_diesel.notes: Average medium diesel passenger car direct combustion emissions per vehicle-kilometre (vkm).

transport_bus.name: Public Transit Bus (Passenger-km)
transport_bus.source: UK DEFRA / DESNZ Greenhouse Gas Reporting: Conversion Factors 2023
transport_bus.notes: Local municipal bus per passenger-kilometre (pkm). Reflects average fleet occupancy. Passenger-km = distance (km) × number of passengers.

transport_train.name: Rail Transit / Train (Passenger-km)
transport_train.source: UK DEFRA / DESNZ Greenhouse Gas Reporting: Conversion Factors 2023
transport_train.notes: National passenger rail transport per passenger-kilometre (pkm). Reflects electrified and diesel fleet passenger-average.

transport_motorcycle.name: Motorcycle / Two-Wheeler (Vehicle-km)
transport_motorcycle.source: UK DEFRA / DESNZ Greenhouse Gas Reporting: Conversion Factors 2023
transport_motorcycle.notes: Average motorcycle/scooter direct emissions per vehicle-kilometre (vkm).
